subject: Pokee AI
object: Pokee-Isaac 28B：可在客户边界内运行的千万级 token 上下文智能体模型
source_quote: Long-horizon agents accumulate context faster than they resolve tasks. Every tool output, observation, and intermediate reasoning step stays in the window, and the two capabilities that matter — holding that context and staying coherent across it — have so far been available almost exclusively from cloud endpoints. That excludes regulated industries, public-sector institutions, and on-device applications, where the data is not permitted to leave the boundary at all. Pokee AI released Pokee-Isaac 28B , a 28B text-only foundation model with a 10M-token context window, designed to run inside that boundary. The Pokee research team claims 93.3% on RULER at 10M tokens, parity with the strongest cost-optimized cloud baselines on agentic benchmarks, and a serving profile that fits a single GPU.

source_quote: “Securing data center capacity is the next step in executing our $44.6 million agreement with Canopy Wave,” said Stephanie Luo, Chief Executive Officer of KIDZ AI. “We are not pursuing capacity on a speculative basis.
